---
title: "Update partner"
---

To update a partner, right click that specific partner.

![An image from the static](/images/partners-update-5cf07ba3f5927dd54ff59a6539dc72c0.png)

From there different configurable options for the partner are presented.

![An image from the static](data:image/png;base64,)

<Info>
It's not possible to remove or delete a Partner if users are connected to it.
</Info>
